projects.description: Built an intentionally vulnerable bookstore web app (Node.js/Express/React, AI-scaffolded) using a tech stack deliberately designed to be exploited, as a personal range for practicing OWASP Top 10 (2021) security testing. Planted vulnerabilities include SQL injection, XSS, IDOR, JWT forgery, insecure password storage, file upload flaws, and SSRF. Identifying and exploiting each flaw with Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, and sqlmap, then remediating with secure coding practices and documenting every fix as a reviewable pull request with a reproduction-and-remediation report.
projects.name: OWASP Bookstore – Web Application Security Lab

responsibilities_and_impact: Uncovered 5 exploitable vulnerabilities across 5+ web and mobile applications via OWASP Top 10 penetration testing including a device integrity bypass that let jailbroken devices evade detection in a banking app, and an IDOR enabling account takeover via request parameter manipulation
Enabled remediation by developing proof-of-concept exploits and authoring vulnerability reports with severity ratings and actionable recommendations
Led a team of 3-5 to plan and execute simulated real-world attack scenarios, driving thorough test coverage
Reduced false positives by 25% by manually validating automated security scans across 4 applications before disclosure
Accelerated secure deployment by collaborating with developers to remediate vulnerabilities and verify fixes pre-release
Delivered 3 client-facing web applications, including a hospital staff publication platform, via responsive front-end development
Built and maintained a dynamic web dashboard for 10+ internal users to manage customer and sales data
Secured sensitive data by administering role-based access and authorization levels for authorized personnel
